reasonForSeparateCollector: The completed rehearsal's preflight requires unused rehearsal roots/units and cannot be rerun against preserved completed scenes. The fixed historical publication preflight also has a three-file scope and prepared-input/authority requirements unsuitable for this metadata-only collection. Neither gate was relaxed.

findings.description: Remote timing starts after packet read/validation and stops before serialization/output; local final acceptance excludes persistence elapsed time.
Binary hashing materializes up to 128 MiB per runtime input instead of a bounded streaming digest.
A missing transport field after remote acceptance records a primary error but can leave local acceptance true.
Separator-format comparison rejects a valid exact parent path before mkdir. Normalize absolute parents without weakening containment.
Path-based directory traversal and leaf-only nofollow do not anchor service-user-controlled parents. Use directory descriptors, component nofollow and identity checks with owned-FD cleanup.
The fixed helper expects the code root, not its node_modules subdirectory. Optional failure must be explicit and must not bypass final protected-baseline checks or erase collected evidence.
capture_output limits are checked only after accumulation, and timeout cleanup lacks a shared deadline. Bound both pipes while reading and bind kill/reap/close to the same deadline.

nextGate: One combined approval for the seven local repair groups, focused complete-path regressions and review, then continuation of the original unused 0/1 read-only collection under the unchanged 20s/35s limit. No extra quota or publication.

synchronization.checksumClassification: All hexadecimal digests are source SHA-256 checksums, not credentials.
